scripts.prep:lib: mkdir -p lib/rich-text && cp ../../packages/rich-text/bootstrap.js ../../packages/rich-text/tiptap-editor.js ../../packages/rich-text/styles.css lib/rich-text/ && cp ../../packages/hedge/lib/guest-session.js lib/guest-session.js && rm -f public/identity.css
scripts.dev: concurrently -n client,server,gen -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server" "npm run gen:watch"
scripts.dev:client: concurrently -n fable,fable-admin,vite -c cyan,magenta,blue "npm run fable:watch" "npm run fable:watch:admin" "vite"
scripts.dev:server: concurrently -n fable-server,wrangler -c green,yellow "npm run fable:watch:server" "wrangler dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:admin && npm run build:server && npm run build:site
scripts.build:site: rm -rf _site && npm run prep:lib && vite build && mkdir -p _site${BASE_PATH}/public _site${BASE_PATH}/lib && cp -r public/* _site${BASE_PATH}/public/ && cp lib/guest-session.js _site${BASE_PATH}/lib/ && { [ -z "${BASE_PATH}" ] || { cp _site${BASE_PATH}/index.html _site/index.html && printf '/ %s/ 302\n' "${BASE_PATH}" > _site/_redirects; }; }
scripts.clean:site: rm -rf src/Server/obj src/Server/bin src/Client/obj src/Client/bin dist
scripts.deploy:justat: npm run clean:site && HEDGE_SITE=justat npm run gen && HEDGE_SITE=justat SITE_ORIGIN=https://justat.at SITE_SLUG=justat SITE_TITLE="just@justat.at" ADMIN_TITLE="just@justat.at admin" SITE_LOGO="/public/justat.png" SITE_FEATURES=blog npm run build && wrangler deploy --env justat
scripts.deploy:ndct: npm run clean:site && HEDGE_SITE=ndct npm run gen && HEDGE_SITE=ndct SITE_ORIGIN=https://nowdochemtrails.net SITE_SLUG=ndct SITE_TITLE="Now Do Chemtrails" ADMIN_TITLE="NDCT admin" SITE_LOGO="/public/ndct.png" npm run build && wrangler deploy --env ndct
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy:justat && npm run deploy:ndct
